reddit.title: I made TalkType for Mac, a small mac app for mac productivity writers ADHD thinkers
reddit.body:
I made TalkType for Mac because subscription-trapped transcription tools that upload private voice audio to distant cloud servers.

What works right now:
- Runs 100% on-device using Apple speech recognition — zero audio leaves your Mac
- No subscription, no login wall, no account required
- Global Push-to-Talk shortcut inserts clean text right into whatever app you are typing in

I would be interested in feedback on whether TalkType for Mac is clear enough on first use, especially on mobile.

https://talktype.app

email.subject: A small app: TalkType for Mac
email.text:
Hey,

I made TalkType for Mac because subscription-trapped transcription tools that upload private voice audio to distant cloud servers.

It is a mac app for mac productivity writers ADHD thinkers.

What it does:

- Apple on-device — free, offline, private. No key, no network.
- No subscription, no login wall, no account required
- subscription-trapped transcription tools that upload private voice audio to distant cloud servers
- Global Push-to-Talk shortcut inserts clean text right into whatever app you are typing in

It is still small, but the core flow is working.

I would be interested in feedback on whether TalkType for Mac is clear enough on first use, especially on mobile.

Download TalkType for Mac at https://talktype.app

Pablo
